statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. NQ remains weekend-closed, so current Tail is low while verified Gulf energy-route disruption keeps Stress extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state remains EA_ON. The scheduled 22:00 UTC Globex reopen is the next evidence checkpoint for gap persistence, retracement depth, repeated extension and cross-asset alignment.
headline: Weekend energy shock leaves Tail low ahead of Sunday NQ reopen
body: NQ is closed until the scheduled Sunday Globex reopen, so current Tail cannot be supported by live continuation or failed-retracement evidence. The Saudi East-West pipeline outage and fresh Hormuz shipping attack keep energy, inflation and rates stress extreme; Tail can change once actual NQ price discovery begins.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding UTC clock hours have published ChatGPT assessments. Tail stayed 19%; Stress was 99% through 02:00 UTC and 100% from 03:00 UTC onward, while Confidence stayed 98% and dominantMode remained normal.
outlookSummary: Risk is concentrated at the 22:00 UTC Globex reopening and first post-open hours. A gap that develops two-way trade or meaningful retracements supports low Tail; repeated extension, shallow pullbacks and aligned oil, yields or volatility would justify a higher Tail band.
